title: CS 4535: Checkpoint 2
description: Due Thu Nov 5, 23:59 ET. Judgment returned within a week.
completedHtml:
Checkpoint 2 submitted.

Your team's review and your individual judgment come back within a week, with the grade we realistically see you getting from here.

elements.name: intro
elements.html: About 20 minutes if your work is linked. Where you can, paste a link. The layout follows the Learning Summary Report: each requirement, then the link that shows it. Checkpoint 3 asks the same things, so whatever you put here carries forward. We read this alongside your team's review and send back a written judgment within a week: on track for your declared band or not, why, and the grade we realistically see you getting from where you are. See Project Milestones & Checkpoints.

elements.name: standing_intro
elements.html: Give your own assessment first, before we send ours. We send back the grade we realistically see you getting, and we compare it with what you say here. If the two disagree, that's worth knowing early, so be honest.

elements.name: lo_standing
elements.title: For each learning outcome, are you on track to meet it at Pass by Dec 10?
elements.description: All eight are required at Pass. See Learning Outcomes.

rows.text: LO1: Get productive in a large, unfamiliar, live codebase
LO2: Work out what's needed, and what "good" means, before building it
LO3: Take a change from problem through deploy and observation
LO4: Review others' work substantively, and respond to review
LO5: Design for operability, and act during an incident
LO6: Decide from evidence about real users
LO7: Collaborate on a shared codebase
LO8: Teach technical work to peers
